tagline: Leading Net Lease Investor in Experiential Real Estate
hero_kpi_rationale: Experiential investments representing 94% of total investment portfolio, aligned with growth trends in the experiential economy and offering a distinct competitive advantage

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total assets of the company after accumulated depreciation
kpis.description: The company holds substantial assets of approximately $5.7 billion across 43 states and Canada

kpis.name: Experiential Investments
kpis.explanation: Investments in experiential properties representing 94% of the total portfolio
kpis.description: The company is heavily invested in experiential properties including theaters, entertainment, attractions, ski, and experiential lodging
kpis.signal: Experiential investments representing the majority of the portfolio

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the entire property portfolio
kpis.description: The company's revenue increased by 3% year-over-year, rising from $698.1 million to $718.4 million

kpis.name: Net Income Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income available to shareholders per diluted share
kpis.description: Net income per diluted share increased strongly by 105%, rising from $1.60 to $3.28 per share

kpis.name: FFOAA Per Share
kpis.explanation: Funds from operations adjusted per diluted share
kpis.description: FFOAA per diluted share increased by 5%, rising from $4.87 to $5.12, reflecting the primary objective of growing predictable and increasing performance

kpis.name: Education Investments
kpis.explanation: Investments in educational properties representing 6% of the total portfolio
kpis.description: The company maintains a limited education portfolio consisting of 46 preschool education centers and 9 private schools, with plans for gradual disposition and recycling of capital into experiential investments

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 3.13 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of 0.09 Bn € in the latest year

risks.title: Global economic and geopolitical uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Direct impact on ability to refinance obligations and secure new financing, volatility in financial and real estate markets

risks.title: Inflation and rising costs
risks.score_rationale: Impact on construction costs, renovation expenses, and tenants' ability to pay rent

risks.title: Credit risks and dependence on debt financing
risks.score_rationale: Significant reliance on debt financing, exposure to covenants and credit market risks

risks.title: Interest rate risks
risks.score_rationale: Direct impact on borrowing costs and ability to refinance existing debt

risks.title: Tenant insolvency and non-payment risk
risks.score_rationale: Dependence on tenants for revenue streams, risk of rental payment defaults

risks.title: Foreign exchange and trade uncertainty risks
risks.score_rationale: Potential impact on costs and revenues from currency fluctuations and trade policy uncertainties

risks.title: Pandemic and business interruption risks
risks.score_rationale: Potential impact on economic activity and tenants' ability to operate

ai_positioning.summary: EPR does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K filing.
